owner_boundary.summary: Lode maps bounded failure classes; Core owns the operation result and Harbor owns live evidence.

classes.trigger: Action identity, requested path, ref or package contract is malformed.

app_mapping.display: 媒体动作合同无效。

classes.recovery_hint: Use exactly one declared action and only the allowed refs/summary fields.

classes.trigger: Required managed page, control, identity or evidence fact is unavailable.

app_mapping.display: 当前小红书媒体页面资源不可用。

classes.recovery_hint: Restore the managed page and collect fresh refs.

classes.trigger: Route, control semantics or readback shape differs from the contract.

app_mapping.display: 页面动作语义已变化，未继续执行。

classes.recovery_hint: Stop and review a new package version; do not retry automatically.

classes.trigger: Target is present but no requested media action/result is available.

app_mapping.display: 页面未提供所请求的媒体动作结果。

classes.recovery_hint: Keep the result empty; do not infer media support.

classes.trigger: Managed identity cannot be confirmed for the creator page.

app_mapping.display: 需要恢复小红书登录状态。

classes.recovery_hint: Restore the managed identity through the product entrypoint.

classes.trigger: Current managed identity cannot control the named action.

app_mapping.display: 当前身份无权执行该媒体动作。

classes.recovery_hint: Use an authorized identity or stop.

classes.trigger: Site challenge or risk control is present.

app_mapping.display: 页面触发风险验证，已停止媒体动作。

classes.recovery_hint: Require explicit user handling; do not bypass or retry.

classes.trigger: User cancels the single authorized media action.

app_mapping.display: 媒体动作已取消。

classes.recovery_hint: Await a new explicit action authorization.

classes.trigger: An image input ref cannot be resolved by its owner.

app_mapping.display: 图片引用不可用，未替换输入。

classes.recovery_hint: Ask the user to provide a new authorized ref; do not read or store media bytes.

classes.trigger: Required text-to-image input or visible generation control is unavailable.

app_mapping.display: 文字配图输入或生成控件不可用。

classes.recovery_hint: Keep generation unknown until the page is safely observed.

classes.trigger: Core reports the selected operation is still running.

app_mapping.display: 媒体动作仍在执行，请等待终态。

classes.recovery_hint: Follow the existing operation ref; do not start a second action.

classes.trigger: Upload/generation may have occurred but terminal result cannot be determined.

app_mapping.display: 媒体动作结果未知，未自动重试。

classes.recovery_hint: Expose the operation ref and recovery entrypoint for reconciliation.

classes.trigger: The named image upload reached a terminal failure.

app_mapping.display: 图片上传失败。

classes.recovery_hint: Show the terminal operation ref and wait for a new authorization before another attempt.

classes.trigger: The named text-to-image generation reached a terminal failure.

app_mapping.display: 文字配图生成失败。

classes.recovery_hint: Show the terminal operation ref; do not silently regenerate.

classes.trigger: The required post-check cannot verify page/media readback.

app_mapping.display: 媒体结果回读校验失败。

classes.recovery_hint: Keep operation and page state unresolved; do not retry.

classes.trigger: Operation ref exists but final page state cannot be reconciled.

app_mapping.display: 媒体页面最终状态未知。

classes.recovery_hint: Use the declared recovery entrypoint; never infer success.

classes.trigger: Production evidence does not prove image order behavior.

app_mapping.display: 图片顺序能力尚未验证。

classes.recovery_hint: Keep order unknown and defer to a later package version.

classes.trigger: Production evidence does not prove replacement behavior.

app_mapping.display: 图片替换能力尚未验证。

classes.recovery_hint: Keep replacement unknown; do not construct a generic media framework.

classes.trigger: Production evidence does not prove removal behavior.

app_mapping.display: 图片删除能力尚未验证。

classes.recovery_hint: Keep removal unknown and defer it to a later version.

classes.trigger: A caller requests save-draft through this media package.

app_mapping.display: 保存草稿不属于当前媒体动作。

classes.recovery_hint: Use the separate save-draft contract only after its own authorization.

classes.trigger: A caller requests publish through this media package.

app_mapping.display: 发布不属于当前媒体动作。

classes.recovery_hint: Use the separate publish contract only after its own authorization.

non_goals: No live error execution, browser automation, or external-effect retry.
No credentials, private runtime state, raw evidence, media bytes, save-draft, or publish behavior.
